title: Эссе: "Мой Путь" (Монолог)
description: Напиши мини-выступление о своем пути к профессии. Используй Future Perfect Continuous (By next year I will have been learning...), Future Perfect (I will have finished...), Future Continuous (This time next year I will be studying...).
topic: Напиши мини-выступление о своем пути к профессии. Используй Future Perfect Continuous (By next year I will have been learning...), Future Perfect (I will have finished...), Future Continuous (This time next year I will be studying...).

conditions.label: Future Perfect Continuous
conditions.hint: By next year I will have been learning...

conditions.label: Future Continuous
conditions.hint: This time next year I will be studying...

script.description: Примерный вариант — «My Path to Becoming an Engineer»:
sentences: My dream is to become an engineer because I enjoy solving problems and creating useful things.
This time next year, I will be studying Maths, Physics, and Computer science at school.
By next year, I will have been preparing for an engineering career for two years.
By the time I finish school, I will have finished my final exams and chosen a university.
In the future, I will work on new technologies and help make people’s lives easier.
